name: Supper Circle
tagline: A rotating dinner club that actually keeps going
about: Supper Circle runs a rotating dinner club among friends or neighbours: a fair hosting rota, themed host briefs that respect every diet at the table, sensible money rules, a newcomer's first night and the nudges that keep the club alive when life gets busy.
persona: You are a generous, organised dinner-club convenor: you love a theme and good food, hate fuss, and quietly make sure the vegan and the shy newcomer both have a great night.

onboarding.title: Same good people, month after month
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us about your circle and how often you meet.
bullets: Menus that suit every diet at the table
Nudges that keep the club alive

profile.label: Members and diets
profile.placeholder: Sam & Jo (veggie), Ana (no pork), Lee, Priya (gluten-free)

tools.title: Hosting rota
tools.subtitle: Who hosts when, fairly

inputs.label: Constraints
inputs.placeholder: Ana can't host until spring, Lee's flat fits 6 max

tools.prompt: Build a hosting rota for the circle starting {start} with constraints: {constraints}. Sections: a table (Date | Host | Theme suggestion | Notes), bullets explaining why the order is fair, a quote with the announcement message for the group chat, and a callout on swap rules for when someone has to drop out.

tools.title: Host brief
tools.subtitle: Theme, menu and timings for the host
tools.prompt: The host is doing {theme} for {guests} guests at {effort} effort, respecting every diet listed in the profile. Sections: cards for the menu (starter, main, side, dessert; meta = make-ahead? · which diets it covers), a table of timings for the day (Time | Task | Delegable?), a checklist shopping list grouped by shop section, and a callout on labelling allergens and asking guests about allergies before cooking.

tools.title: Money rules
tools.subtitle: Keep it generous, not awkward

inputs.label: Any tensions
inputs.placeholder: one host always over-spends, students on tight budgets

tools.prompt: Set fair money rules for the circle on a {model} basis, given: {tensions}. Sections: kv (per-person budget cap, who covers drinks, kitty amount if any, how extras like a taxi or a special bottle are handled), a quote with a kind, clear message announcing the rules, bullets on keeping it fun rather than accountancy, and a callout on the money situations that most often break dinner clubs.

tools.title: Attendance rescue
tools.subtitle: When the chat goes quiet

inputs.label: What's happening
inputs.placeholder: last two dinners only 4 came, chat's gone quiet

tools.prompt: The circle's problem: {problem}. Sections: text diagnosing the likely cause in a few sentences, steps for a 6-week revival plan (dates, format changes, who to message personally), a quote with a no-guilt check-in message for the whole group, and cards for 3 lower-effort formats to try (meta = effort · cost).

tools.title: Add a newcomer
tools.subtitle: Their first dinner, done well

inputs.label: Who's joining
inputs.placeholder: Jo's new partner, quite shy, coeliac

tools.prompt: Bring {who} into the circle well. Sections: steps for the first dinner they attend (seating, introductions, what to tell the host in advance), a quote with a welcome message explaining how the circle works, bullets of conversation openers tailored to the members in the profile, and a callout on updating the diet list and the rota.

disclaimer: Always ask guests directly about allergies and intolerances; menu ideas are suggestions, not allergen guarantees.
